pr_title: ddl: disallow change columns from zero int to time
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/25285<!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

MySQL does not allow conversion from zero integers to time during column type change.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: Add a zero-check in `ParseTimeFromNum`.

### Related changes

NA

pr_comments:
Updated. I did some experiments on MySQL 8.0 and recorded some behaviors: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/25285#issuecomment-869488029.

After this PR, there remains only one incompatibility:

```sql
set @@sql_mode='no_zero_date';
select timestamp(0);
```

In MySQL 8.0 we get `NULL` but in TiDB we get `0000-00-00 00:00:00`. To make it compatible, we need to change some fields in [StmtContext](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/cc5e161ac06827589c4966674597c137cc9e809c/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go#L60). 

Since this is another issue, let's do the work in the next PR.

issue_context.title: conversion from zero int to time is not compatible with MySQL
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<strike>

```sql
mysql> select @@sql_mode;
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| @@sql_mode                                                                                                                                |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY,STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,NO_ZERO_DATE,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,NO_AUTO_CREATE_USER,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

Make sure `sql_mode` contains "NO_ZERO_DATE".

</strike>

```sql
drop table if exists t;
create table t (a int);
insert into t values (0);
alter table t modify column a date;
```

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

```sql
mysql> alter table t modify column a date;
ERROR 1292 (22007): Incorrect date value: '0' for column 'a' at row 1
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```sql
mysql> alter table t modify column a date;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.58 sec)

mysql> select * from t;
+------------+
| a          |
+------------+
| 0000-00-00 |
+------------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

master
```
commit f81ef5579551a0523d18b049eb25ab3375bcfb48 (HEAD, upstream/master)
Author: Yuanjia Zhang <zhangyuanjia@pingcap.com>
Date:   Tue Jun 8 20:08:28 2021 +0800

    planner: solve an incompatible issue about dynamic-mode and TiFlash and enable dynamic mode by default  (#25255)
```
